name: Playable Dracula
author: sergiomanzur
description:
Play the castle as its master.

Dracula trades Alucard's agility for reach and weight: a three-way Hellfire fan, a charged Dark Inferno, a shattering teleport instead of a dodge, a rain of meteors, and a bat swarm to reposition.

Pick your character under Settings. Switching is instant and never writes to your save.
